s.g: (medicine) quaque hora: every hour - used in medical pharmacy prescriptions usually with a numeral defining hours between doses. "q4h" read as: "taken every 4 hours". Also common is the format: "3 caps q4h" read as" means "Take 3 capsules every 4 hours."

qhd.f: (television) Initialism of quad high definition (“2560×1440 pixels”).
(video, television, computer graphics) Initialism of quarter high definition (“960x540 pixels”).
